prompt: Priya left one comment on a stranger’s issue and now gets notified about every reply. Why?
explanation: You are automatically subscribed to threads you participate in — authoring, commenting, or being @mentioned. Participating is one of the two main notification sources, alongside deliberately watching a repository.

options.text: Participating in a conversation subscribes her to its thread
She is following the repository author
GitHub notifies everyone in the organization
Commenting assigns the issue to her
